bibl.title: Notes on the papyri of Plato and the constitution of the text.
bibl.seg: Maria Vittoria Curtolo, Notes on the papyri of Plato and the constitution of the text.
bibl.note: Confirmation of suspected medieval readings. - New correct readings of the papyri. - New adiaphora that can improve the text. - "Radical" variants. - Readings that can help choose between adiaphora.
